steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Verify you land on a signed-in page (e.g. the home/dashboard page showing the admin user) and report what page you are on.

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' in OpenProject and open its work packages list. Report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen. Do not modify anything. Also report the total number of work packages listed.

03-create: In the project 'Bench Project' in OpenProject, create a new work package of type 'Task' with the subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench work package created for run {{runid}}'). Save it and verify it was created. Report the work package's numeric ID as displayed (OpenProject shows it like #123), its subject, and its type.

04-set: On the work package page for work package {{03-create.id_as_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project, set the Assignee field to the user 'Bench Assignee'. The assignee field is an autocomplete: type the name and actually select the matching option from the dropdown that appears so the value is saved (not merely typed). The field saves in place. Verify the Assignee field now displays 'Bench Assignee' on the page and report exactly what it shows.

05-change: On the work package page for work package {{03-create.id_as_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project, change the Status field to 'In progress'. The status field is edited in place (click it, choose 'In progress' from the dropdown, it saves automatically). Verify the Status field now displays 'In progress' on the page and report exactly what it shows.

06-set: On the work package page for work package {{03-create.id_as_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project, set the Finish date field to 2026-12-31. The date field is edited in place (click it, enter the date, it saves automatically). Verify the Finish date field now displays 2026-12-31 on the page and report exactly what it shows.

07-add: On the work package page for work package {{03-create.id_as_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment and verify it appears in the work package's activity/comments. Report the exact comment text as displayed and confirm it is visible on the page.

08-open: Open work package {{03-create.id_as_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project and read back its current state without changing anything. Report exactly: (1) the work package ID as displayed (like {{03-create.id_as_displayed}}), (2) the subject, (3) the type, (4) the description text, (5) the Assignee name shown, (6) the Status shown, (7) the Finish date shown, (8) whether a comment containing '{{runid}}' is visible in the activity and its text. Read these from the page itself.

09-open: In the project 'Bench Project' in OpenProject, open the work packages list and make sure the view shows ALL work packages (not just open ones — switch to a view/filter that includes closed ones, e.g. 'All' or clear the open filter). Report the subjects of every work package whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown, and the total count of work packages listed. Do not modify anything.
